lesson: Sign functionals of the theta-normalised kernel up to order 4 do not separate Euler products from the controls: the character kernels break the Polya-frequency sign pattern more often than E_a, backward heat, EIS-w and theta^w do, so anything one-signed on the L-functions is also one-signed on those classes and on the battery DH function. Backward heat only pushes order-2 expressions further in the direction log-concavity already gives (Lemma H). Total positivity of a local coefficient sequence says nothing about dilation minors of the kernel (T-NR prediction refuted). Float64 is blind where polar terms dominate (about 20% of entries) and gave one wrong sign on a cancelled polar kernel before a noise rule was added; ball arithmetic was needed there.
